name: Adam Baldwin
biography: has over 10+ years of mostly self taught computer security experience and currently is the co-founder and Chief Pwning Officer at nGenuity focusing on security of web applications. He at one time possessed a GCIA and if his CPE's are up to date should still have a CISSP. Prior to starting nGenuity Adam worked for Symantec. Adam is a minor contributor to the W3AF project and has previously spoke at Toorcamp, Djangcon 2010, and JSconf 2011.
